events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Christine Ellen Hynde, born on September 7, 1951, is an American-British singer, songwriter, and musician, best known as the frontwoman of The Pretenders.

angles.name: Rock Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and fierce attitude with The Pretenders have given us decades of amazing rock.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: William John Paul Gallagher, born September 21, 1972, is an English singer and songwriter, globally recognised as the lead vocalist of Oasis.

angles.name: Oasis Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher – still bringing the noise and the unforgettable tunes.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album is 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album "Imagine" was released in the UK on October 8, 1971, featuring his signature song of the same name.

angles.name: Imagine at 55
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. The powerful message of peace and unity from his seminal album is as relevant today as it was in 1971.

events.title: The first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music and putting "1,000 songs in your pocket."

angles.name: iPod Quarter Century
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? It's 25 years since Apple unveiled the original iPod, changing how we carry our music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, naturally) to 007 and over six decades of iconic espionage, thrilling chases, and unforgettable theme tunes.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, would have been 86 on October 9, having been born in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and screenwriter John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, turns 87 on October 27.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel mayhem, his comedic genius is truly timeless. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' is 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as "The White Album," was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed their sprawling 'White Album' upon the world. A double LP that broke all the rules and still sounds incredible today.

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: November 24 marks 35 years since the death of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, who passed away in 1991 at the age of 45.

angles.name: Tribute to Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice, stage presence, and legacy with Queen remain unmatched. Forever a champion.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' is 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" in the UK on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries and set new standards for pop music. A true masterpiece.

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's death
events.blurb: December 8 marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, who was fatally shot in New York City in 1980 at the age of 40.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the music world lost a giant. Remembering John Lennon, whose legacy of peace, love, and incredible music lives on.
